resets.asserted_meaning: Asynchronously sets count_out to parameter S0=8; count is not reset by this process.

ports.name: reset
ports.role: Active-high asynchronous reset of count_out only.

ports.name: load
ports.role: Four-state sequence-enable control; low loads S0 into internal count at a clock edge.

ports.name: enable
ports.role: Four-state qualification of sequence progression when load is high.

ports.name: clk
ports.role: Rising-edge clock for both RTL sequential processes.

ports.name: count_out
ports.role: Registered output in the fixed 14-value state sequence.

ports.name: count
ports.role: Exposed internal next-count register, not initialized or asynchronously reset by RTL.

declared_unknowns.description: count has no reset or initialization. Two RTL always blocks assign count_out; when reset is asserted simultaneously with load=1 and enable=0, both blocks schedule writes to count_out and procedural ordering is not specified. This collision is not tested. A directed X-valued load check verifies that no branch is taken and count holds.
RTL parameters S0..S13 determine sequence values; this model preserves the supplied default values (8,7,11,4,9,2,5,12,6,3,15,1,14,13).
Clock and reset SystemC ports use bool and are modeled only for binary 0/1 levels; X/Z on clock or reset is outside the modeled verification scope.
